description: The bar chart illustrates “Average Performance” values for five labeled methods, shown as a single series of vertical bars. The horizontal axis contains the method categories in left-to-right order: Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, ClnGS (w/), and ClnGS; there is no separate x-axis label visible. The vertical axis is labeled “Average Performance” and uses a linear numeric scale with tick marks at regular 10-unit intervals, spanning approximately from 0 up to 60. Each category is represented by one solid-colored bar: Standard is orange at roughly 53, Self-RAG is a yellow/olive bar at roughly 54, FactTune is light green at roughly 52, ClnGS (w/) is medium blue at roughly 54, and ClnGS is dark blue at roughly 59–60. The bars are not stacked or grouped beyond the single series, there is no legend shown, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis effects; the categories appear in a fixed labeled order rather than being explicitly sorted by value.
